name: Caterpillar
desc: A small, chubby green caterpillar with two big black eyes and tiny antennae. It curls up low to the ground and has a round, segmented body.

name: Ladybug
desc: A large, blocky ladybug with a dark navy blue body and bright red wings with black spots. It has four sturdy legs and two short antennae sticking out from its head.

name: Rhino Beetle
desc: A big, dark blue beetle with two large horn-like spikes on its head. It has a heavy, angular shell on its back and four thick legs.

name: Spider
desc: A massive dark blue spider with six long, sharp legs spread wide. It has a large triangular body and four big black eyes on the front of its face.
